limitations: Body mass is a published model estimate for PIN 552-1, not a species range or direct fossil measurement.
Hip height is a 0.8 hindlimb-length posture proxy, not a direct fossil or emitted-rig measurement.
Uniform geometry scaling does not infer segment masses, inertias, tissue stress, muscle force or contact-force distribution.
Taxon-level S4 limb proportions lack a specimen identifier and reveal a relative-segment mismatch; they are comparison evidence, not permission to resize bones.
This evidence binding does not establish biological validation or production approval.
